title: The Stag and the Fawn
summary: A young fawn asked his father: "Father, you have mighty antlers, swift legs, and a colossal body; why do you flee whenever a hound barks?"...
full_text:
A young fawn asked his father: "Father, you have mighty antlers, swift legs, and a colossal body; why do you flee whenever a hound barks?"

The stag smiled ruefully: "My child, everything you say is true, yet the moment I hear the bark of a dog, my knees tremble and my hooves carry me away before I can think!"
moral: Inherited instinct often overrules theoretical bravery.
